_readme: HER LANES - the wife's side of the I5 Couple Compatibility venn, RULE-DEFINED rather than learned.
The household shares one Plex account, so there is no per-person history to mine for her; taste-graph only
knows 'michael' and 'kids'. Rather than invent a persona out of thin air, her side is this hand-written
config. Edit it freely - couple_compat.py re-reads it every run and never writes back.
MATCHER (producers\couple_compat.py): a lane matches a film when EVERY non-empty condition below holds.
An empty (or absent) list is 'no opinion' and is skipped, so a lane with only actors_any is purely a
cast lane. Genre and actor names are matched case-insensitively against the Plex genres[]/actors[] on each
unwatched-pool item (actors are Plex's top-billed cast only, so a deep-cut supporting role will not match).
genres_all : every listed genre must be present on the film
genres_any : at least one listed genre must be present
actors_any : at least one listed actor must be in the billed cast
